haiku.problem: Opens with 'Friends' and says Papa Dorin is speaking directly to the listener's group, which is fine, but also says 'I spent years in the back of a junk drawer' as a personal aside. The junk drawer is in his backstory so this is allowed, but the card also states 'Abraham, Isaac and Jacob... knew Him as God Almighty' which goes beyond the verse by asserting they knew Him, not just that He appeared to them. Minor reasoning stretch.

Explanation says 'The answer is that He will take them as His own people' and then adds 'The leaving is only part of it.' Acceptable, but the junk-drawer aside repeats an identical personal line used on card 1-2 family of lines; not a rule break on its own.
Says 'There's no trimming and no leaving out the hard parts,' which adds an interpretation not stated in the verse (Exodus 6:29), a small stretch of the text.
